reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Service for Foreign Policy Instruments

title.narrative: EU-ASEAN Think Tank dialogues for strategic partnerships

description.narrative: This project consists of exchanges on the topics of i) Digital Connectivity; ii) Stability in the region in relation to the ASEAN vision on the Free and Open Indo Pacific (henceforward: FOIP); and iii) climate adaptation. The outcome of the exchanges will be increased awareness on, and increased engagement, with civil society in the EU and ASEAN on these three topics. Additionally, the exchanges will lay the foundation for continued dialogue on an academic, political and economic level.

description.narrative: Outputs: Better awareness of role in EU in digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific, climate adaptation. Better awareness of the ASEAN role in digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific and climate adaptation. A policy brief on EUASEAN cooperation in the field of digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific and climate adaptation. Facilitation of synergies, coordination and exchange of best practices between relevant actors in the EU and the ASEAN region in the field of digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific and climate adaptation. Activities / Organize annually: 2 digital expert roundtables 2 digital dialogues with civil society1 public conference In addition to this, in the second and third year respectively the following activities will be organised: 1 essay competition 1 physical conference in Cambodia

Better awareness of the ASEAN role in digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific and climate adaptation. A policy brief on EUASEAN cooperation in the field of digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific and climate adaptation. Facilitation of synergies, coordination and exchange of best practices between relevant actors in the EU and the ASEAN region in the field of digital connectivity, ASEAN vision on IndoPacific and climate adaptation. Activities / Organize annually: 2 digital expert roundtables 2 digital dialogues with civil society1 public conference In addition to this, in the second and third year respectively the following activities will be organised: 1 essay competition 1 physical conference in Cambodia
